text: When we look to the individuals of the same variety or sub-variety of our older cultivated plants and animals, one of the first points which strikes us, is, that they generally differ much more from each other, than do the individuals of any one species or variety in a state of nature. When we look to the individuals of the same variety or sub-variety of older cultivated plants and animals, one of the first points which strikes us is that they generally differ much more from each other than do the individuals of any one species or variety in a state of nature. On the other hand, one of the five points which Aristotle makes is that they generally offer more aroma for a species or variety in a state of nature.
